dedupe_keys.name: consumption based carbon accounts harmonized emissions data

description: This Zenodo release contains harmonised consumption-based carbon account results and uncertainty information drawn from several global input-output models. The own record lists a model-comparison CSV, a production-and-consumption workbook and explanatory documentation. A modeller can compare simulated sectoral demand or trade-induced emissions against these accounts, or use the spread across models as an uncertainty bound. These accounts track economic emissions embodied in consumption; they do not locate individual industrial plants or electricity network flows. The article normalises model outputs against a common base year, so users need to preserve that transformation when comparing raw inventories. Zenodo reports CC BY 4.0 for the current version reached by the stable concept DOI. I read own repository metadata and the descriptor without opening files. The associated CBCA analysis code is reviewed as a separate platform item. No exact catalogue coverage was found. The related CBCA analysis code is reviewed separately as a platform item.
